name: AnyMind Group Inc.
summary: AnyMind Group Inc., a technology company, provides a platform for brand building, production management, media operations, e-commerce site development and management, marketing, and logistics management in Japan. The company provides AnyAI, an AI platform for collecting, visualizing, and utilizing brand data; AnyLive, an AI live commerce platform; AnyX, an e-commerce management platform that enables centralized management of multiple e-commerce channels; AnyTag, an influencer marketing platform; AnyManager, a one-stop platform for web and app publishers; and AnyCreator, supports a various areas including content creation, monetization, and channel and account growth.
